messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 pager fired for sustained 5xx from dedicated pool `tidewell-prod-a`. Affected: Tidewell Analytics (enterprise). Oncall: @oncall-jess. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/tidewell-dedicated-5xx. Detected 2026-04-07T09:15:00Z.

oncall-jess: taking it. quick glance at metrics — error rate ~12% over last 3m, p95 latency jumps. starting packet captures and will tail logs.

eng-liam: I'm in. seeing kernel retry loops on gpu-05 and rapid memory reclaim. recent runtime patch rm-kernel-2026-04-07 applied to some pools ~09:05 UTC. suspect regression.

oncall-jess: can we isolate to rollback that patch on this pool? what's risk?

eng-liam: rollback possible. prefer canary rollback to 2 nodes then full. estimate 15-25m to complete incl monitoring. will trigger now.

acct-zoe: assembling impacted account contacts and routing. Tidewell Analytics is enterprise dedicated. Primary: Jonah Varela (jonah@tidewell.ai) / +1 646-555-0147 (cell) / escalation: +1 646-555-0199. Secondary: ArborBank (shared infra) may see increased latency 12min window. Contact: anika@arborbank.com / +44 7900 111222. Helios Med (private) listed on same tenancy for audit notes.

acct-zoe: routing plan: if escalates to customer-impact P1, phone Jonah immediately, then email ArborBank ops, CC CS and account team. Helios Med to be notified via their compliance channel only if data plane impacted.

eng-liam: initiating canary rollback on nodes g-02 and g-03. Monitoring: 5xx rate, gpu memory pressure, kernel retry counts.

oncall-jess: tail logs:
```
[2026-04-07T09:15:12Z] inference: request id=fb2c - start
[2026-04-07T09:15:12Z] runtime: kernel retry=3, alloc failed 1.8G
[2026-04-07T09:15:13Z] gpu-05: driver warn: mem_pressure high
[2026-04-07T09:15:15Z] runtime: responding 502 upstream backlog=96
```

eng-liam: canary nodes look stable after rollback (g-02/g-03). 5xx dropped from 12% -> 1.5% on canary. extending to 6 nodes then full.

cs-maya: drafting short status page and customer note. keeping it factual, no technical jargon. will paste below.

cs-maya: STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Status: Partial Outage (Degraded) 109:15 UTC
Service: Dedicated inference pool tidewell-prod-a
Impact: Some inference requests may return 5xx errors or see increased latency. A runtime change deployed earlier is suspected and is being rolled back. Engineers are performing a staged rollback; mitigation expected within ~25 minutes.
Customer actions: Retry requests or fallback to cached responses where possible. For enterprise customers, account team will reach out directly.
```

acct-zoe: small ask: add link to support contact and a short note: "No customer data was exfiltrated; we are investigating allocation failures only."

cs-maya: added that line.

oncall-jess: start customer call list: I'm calling Jonah now.

acct-zoe: CUSTOMER EMAIL (short):
```
Subject: Incident: Inference errors affecting Tidewell Analytics (ongoing)
Hi Jonah,

We detected elevated errors and latency for your dedicated inference pool (tidewell-prod-a) starting at ~09:15 UTC. Our engineers rolled back a recent runtime change which appears to have caused allocation failures; a staged rollback is underway and we expect service to return to normal within ~25 minutes.

What you might see: some requests returning 5xx or longer response times. No customer data was accessed or modified.

If you need immediate assistance, call your account lead at +1 646-555-0147. We'll follow up with a post-incident report.

Regards,
Redwood Support Team
```

eng-liam: full rollback finished at 09:36 UTC across all nodes. Post-rollback metrics: 5xx <0.5%, queue length back to baseline. No further driver OOMs observed.

oncall-jess: verified user-facing errors cleared. marking incident mitigated.

statusbot: Updating status page... :gear:

statusbot: Status changed to "Mitigated" for tidewell-prod-a. Incident record created IR-2933330000. Postmortem assigned.

acct-zoe: Jonah confirmed on call he can see errors clearing and requested a 30-min follow-up check-in. he asked for a postmortem and root cause note for their compliance team. noted.

ana-oncall: taking 2-hr monitoring handoff. please mute noisy alerts, page only on >1% sustained 5xx or kernel-retry spikes.

cs-maya: posting customer follow-up email now and attaching timeline. will prepare public status update and internal comms template for postmortem.

eng-liam: for postmortem: we'll include kernel-retry histograms, rollout metadata (which pools got rm-kernel-2026-04-07), and action items: add rollout gating by mem-pressure telemetry + automatic rollback threshold.

oncall-jess: thanks team. good coordination. closing active paging at 09:46 UTC. postmortem due in 72 hours. :memo:
